candidates.instruction: Remove the arbiter’s registered `wr_en` state and derive the register file write enable from the registered grant being nonzero; retain the registered write address and data. Preserve the one-cycle registered write channel behavior, including idle cycles and synchronous reset blocking writes, as well as round-robin grant behavior and read-first memory behavior. Check routed LUT and FF counts, WNS and WHS, and require every deterministic verification gate to pass before accepting the candidate.
